title: Claude Now Works While My Laptop Is Closed
description:
Claude Routines let you schedule jobs that Claude runs on its own, and if you set the routine to cloud it executes on Anthropic's servers, so it keeps working when your laptop is closed. You write the instructions once, pick a time, and attach the connectors you already use. Pro plans get five cloud runs a day and Max gets fifteen. Good starting routines include a daily inbox triage, a Sunday priorities email, a competitor watch and a weekly metrics summary. Routines currently require a paid plan and sit under the Code tab in the Claude desktop app.

Get the full setup guide here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1kHgfjyr1BWXK08svzucP3v3zD4Vhe8bF47OxTtH99j4/edit?usp=sharing
